summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the Senate rose sharply, with the party still favoured. The projected seat count is now 50-50, which would leave the chamber split evenly, and was 53-47 before. In [[Mississippi]], the Democrat Scott Colom made a sharp gain and the market now sees a predicted flip, while in [[Nebraska]] the Republican Pete Ricketts also gained sharply.
summaries.governor: Four governor's races saw sharp moves in the Polymarket odds over the last day. In [[Nevada]], the Democrat Aaron Ford gained a lot of ground, and the market treats the seat as a predicted flip. The Democrats Cindy Holscher in [[Kansas]] and Tina Kotek in Oregon also strengthened sharply.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds show the Democrats' chances of winning House control rose by a sizable amount, and they remain the favoured party. The projected seat count has also changed, now 240-193-1, down from 248-186, and the market still points to Democrats gaining control. Two North Carolina races saw sharp gains for the Democrats, with Cyril Jefferson in [[NC-06 (High Point & Kannapolis)]] and Lakesha Womack in [[NC-14 (Gastonia & Huntersville)]] each improving their standing, and both are listed as predicted flips.
